**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `02f27aabf2a58f94d1383846fc1ad40b4d72ddf5`.

Verified `65fc109..02f27aa` changes only `directory_http.rs` and the API doc. Production gates, runtime code, migration and OMP own-process cache are identical. The [65fc109 cost verdict](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/pull/152#issuecomment-6711957477), including P152-F004 closure and deployment debt, carries forward: no new timer, poll, recurring work or launch site.

The strengthened fixture helper opens/closes a SQLite pool and reads/parses all pending/running delivery payloads for its target before sender filtering, rather than peeking only the head. Its connection/query and payload-byte costs scale with the test fixture's jobs per assertion, not live seats or daemon ticks. The new documenting regression adds one isolated rig/two sends; it changes no production behavior.

Exact-head [CI 42407240181](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42407240181) succeeds. JUnit confirms **all 82 directory HTTP cases passed**, including the documenting pane-replay positive that finds both queued messages through the strengthened helper; **2,162 executed Rust cases, zero failures/errors** overall. Latest Delivers **42407241684** succeeds at this SHA.

No local build, test, mutation, runtime probe or worktree edit. Herring/reviewer own the clarified C32 acceptance and Known-limit grade; this cost pass is not an F88 closure. Same-incarnation deployment/legitimate traffic proof remains owed.
